query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `auditLog` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `companyId` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `branchId` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `entityType` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `entityId` int NOT NULL,
  `entityName` varchar(300) DEFAULT NULL,
  `action` enum('CRIACAO','EDICAO','EXCLUSAO','ATIVACAO','DESATIVACAO') NOT NULL,
  `changes` text,
  `userId` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `userName` varchar(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  INDEX `audit_entity_idx` (`entityType`, `entityId`),
  INDEX `audit_company_idx` (`companyId`),
  INDEX `audit_date_idx` (`createdAt`),
  INDEX `audit_user_idx` (`userId`),
  INDEX `audit_action_idx` (`action`)
);
